description: Recommends one-way protected bike lanes on Victoria Avenue (Taylor to Ruth).
Includes new sidewalks and accessibility ramps.

chips.text: Councillor Pears questioned the 'field of dreams' mentality for low current bike usage.
Residents adjacent to Victoria Avenue and surrounding neighborhoods are affected.
No specific winter bike traffic data exists for this Victoria Avenue segment.
Public engagement showed mixed support, with adjacent residents more likely to oppose.
Councillor Pears opposed due to lack of usage data and high snow removal costs.
Three mature trees would be removed for sidewalk installation.

description: Committee recommends new limited residential parking zone in Nutana East.
New zone responds to two resident petitions.
The zone costs $4,700 from existing budget.
City Solicitor to amend parking bylaw.

chips.text: Staff confirmed permit fee increases could achieve cost recovery for parking zones.
Residents in three Nutana East blocks will be affected by new parking rules.
A broader review of the residential parking program will be completed by fall 2026.
